title: Answer: no theory of information, experience matches information structure

statements.text: The view has no theory of information as such. Its closest claim is that the structure of human experience matches high-level information structure in the brain rather than its spatial structure, which Chalmers calls perhaps the best option for a panpsychist and Goff builds into the thinning law.

sources.quote: Most obviously, one can suggest macrophenomenal structure is isomorphic to certain information structure in the brain.
Contemporary neuroscience suggests that the structure of human consciousness corresponds to high-level information structures in the brain.
